scripts.build: astro build && node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readdirSync, unlinkSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; function prune(dir){ if (!existsSync(dir)) return; for (const f of readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})) { const p=join(dir,f.name); if (f.isDirectory()) prune(p); else if (f.name.startsWith('client.')) unlinkSync(p); } } prune('dist'); prune('.vercel/output');"
